title: 10 倒计时10
content_zh:
衡拓办公室的隔音本就好，现在更是安静得像抽了真空般，连空调运转的声音都听不见。
游决走了，倪夏的羞愤和难为情反而在胸口飞速膨胀，根本不敢回想这些天的事儿。
【谷雨声】：我昨天打听了一下现在的IP市场，今时不同往日，咱们现在想续版权可不是当年那个价格了！
【谷雨声】：我在回来的路上了，我约了版权方过两天面谈，先看什么情况。
从昨晚到现在还没吃饭，倪夏也没什么食欲，只是肚子的叫声在抗议。
倪夏往身后的餐桌看去，纸质凭证和各种物料堆积如山，手机电脑里还有一堆聊天记录等着整理。
content_en:
The sound insulation in Hengtuo's office was already good, but now it was as quiet as a vacuum, and you couldn't even hear the sound of the air conditioner running.
After You Jue left, Ni Xia's shame, anger and embarrassment swelled rapidly in her chest, and she didn't dare to think about what happened these days.
[Gu Yusheng]: Yesterday I inquired about the current IP market. Today is different from the past. If we want to renew the copyright now, the price will not be the same as it was back then!
[Gu Yusheng]: I'm on my way back. I've made an appointment with the copyright owner in two days to see what happens.
Ni Xia hasn't eaten since last night and has no appetite. She just has a growling stomach in protest.
Ni Xia looked at the dining table behind her. Paper vouchers and various materials were piled up. There were also a bunch of chat records waiting to be sorted out on her mobile phone and computer.
